xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4583: Editor pane: allow reading markdown anywhere under $HOME; keep writes limited to project roots

plan.title: Editor pane: allow reading markdown anywhere under $HOME; keep writes limited to project roots
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The internal markdown editor pane refuses to open markdown files outside a registered project (e.g. ~/Projects/OpenMontage/.../script.md) with 'Path is outside the allowed project roots'. readFileAtPath and writeFileAtPath share one validateAndResolve() in src/dashboard/server/services/file-at-path.ts whose containment check accepts only registered project roots + OVERDECK_HOME, so reads were narrowed as a side effect of the write allowlist.
narratives.Proposal: Give validateAndResolve a door argument ('read' | 'write'). Reads accept a realpath inside the operator's home directory (realpath(os.homedir())) or a write root; writes accept write roots only, unchanged. ReadFileAtPathResult gains a required writable: boolean (true when inside a write root). EditorPane opens writable:false files read-only (readonly textarea, Save and Ctrl/Cmd+S disabled, a read-only note). docs/MARKDOWN-EDITOR-PANE.md documents the split and a 'Who can call this door' analysis: every /ws/rpc caller holds the admin scope, which already grants a shell via /ws/terminal, and no Shared Sessions host transport exists in this repo. After pan done opens the PR, the work agent pastes the PRD's 'Security analysis — who can call /ws/rpc' section into the PR description (issue AC-8) and addresses CodeRabbit comments before merge.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to which files writeFileAtPath accepts; it still accepts registered project roots + OVERDECK_HOME only
- No file creation by either door
- No widening for non-markdown files; .md/.mdx/.markdown on both given and resolved path stays required
- No change to the 1 MiB read cap, the 4096-char path limit, or the absolute-path rule
- No new RPC method, no new error code, no new npm dependency
- No change to MarkdownFileLink routing or the markdown open-target preference
- No Shared Sessions transport work
- No 'make writable' / 'register project' action in the read-only note
- No change to isInsidePath semantics

autoDecisions.summary: Inject the home root in tests by mocking node:os homedir with a spread of the real module
autoDecisions.rationale: src/lib/paths.ts exports no home constant; importing homedir from node:os in file-at-path.ts and mocking it keeps tests off the real home directory (issue AC-6) while tmpdir() keeps working.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep one validateAndResolve with a door: 'read' | 'write' argument returning { realPath, writable }
autoDecisions.rationale: Preserves the existing check order and write error precedence exactly, and hands readFileAtPath the writable bit without a second containment pass.

autoDecisions.summary: Read rejection message is 'Path is outside your home directory and the registered project roots'; write rejection keeps 'Path is outside the allowed project roots'
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue fixes the code (PATH_NOT_ALLOWED) but not the read message; a distinct message tells the operator the actual read boundary.

autoDecisions.summary: EditorPane fails closed: only writable === true is editable; existing test mocks gain writable: true
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires that the operator never type edits that can only fail on save; failing closed guarantees that even for a malformed result.

autoDecisions.summary: Contract change and server change ship as one work item
autoDecisions.rationale: Adding a required field to ReadFileAtPathResult breaks npm run typecheck until readFileAtPath returns it, so the two cannot land independently.

autoDecisions.summary: The PR-description security analysis (issue AC-8) is also committed as a 'Who can call this door' section in docs/MARKDOWN-EDITOR-PANE.md
autoDecisions.rationale: The PR is opened by pan done after items complete, so a PR-body AC cannot gate an item; committing the analysis to docs makes it durable and reviewable from the diff, and the PR body copies it.

autoDecisions.summary: The /ws/rpc caller analysis concludes the widening is acceptable; planning does not stop
autoDecisions.rationale: authorizeDashboardUpgrade requires the admin scope for /ws/rpc (ws-auth.ts lines 33-48, DASHBOARD-AUTH.md line 72); admin satisfies operate, which opens /ws/terminal as the same user; no Shared Sessions host transport exists in src/apps/packages.

metadata.sizeJustification: Three small items across contracts, one server service, one frontend pane, and one doc page.

items.title: Split file-at-path containment by door and return writable from readFileAtPath

expected_outputs: file-at-path.test.ts passes, including the new $HOME, sibling-prefix, symlink-escape, non-markdown, and write-rejection tests

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 exactly. (1) packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts: add required `writable: Schema.Boolean` (with the PRD's doc comment) to ReadFileAtPathResult; replace the ReadFileAtPathRpc comment's last sentence with the PRD text describing home root + write roots and writable; add the PATH_NOT_ALLOWED sentence to WriteFileAtPathRpc's comment. (2) src/dashboard/server/services/file-at-path.ts: import homedir from node:os; rename resolveAllowedRoots -> resolveWriteRoots with the new comment; add resolveHomeRoot() returning realpath(homedir()) or null; give validateAndResolve(path, door: 'read' | 'write') and return { realPath, writable }; replace the containment block (old lines 98-101) with the PRD's after-snippet (write outside write roots -> PATH_NOT_ALLOWED 'Path is outside the allowed project roots'; read outside write roots and outside home root -> PATH_NOT_ALLOWED 'Path is outside your home directory and the registered project roots'); readFileAtPath passes 'read' and returns writable; writeFileAtPath passes 'write'; add a module header comment. Do not change isInsidePath. (3) file-at-path.test.ts: add state.home, create tempRoot/home in beforeEach, add the PRD's vi.mock('node:os', ...) with the importOriginal spread, add writable: true to the existing project-root toEqual, and add the named tests listed in PRD WI-1 Step 3.

items.title: Given a .md file under the mocked home root and outside every write root, when readFileAtPath is called, then it returns the file text with writable: false
Given a .md file inside the registered project root or OVERDECK_HOME (both outside the mocked home), when readFileAtPath is called, then it returns writable: true

Given the test file mocks node:os homedir to a temp directory, when file-at-path.test.ts runs, then no test reads the real home directory; and ReadFileAtPathResult in rpc.ts contains writable: Schema.Boolean with a doc comment describing the read roots
Render writable:false files read-only in EditorPane

expected_outputs: EditorPane.test.tsx passes, including the new read-only tests and the existing save/conflict tests with writable: true mocks

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-2 exactly. In EditorPane.tsx: add writable: boolean to the ready LoadState; loadFile sets writable: r.writable === true; derive const writable = load.status === 'ready' && load.writable; save() returns early unless load.writable; handlePaneKeyDown keeps preventDefault but only calls save() when writable && dirty && !saving (add writable to deps); Save button disabled={!writable || !dirty || saving}; textarea gets readOnly={!writable} and onChange only when writable; render a note with data-testid="editor-pane-readonly-note" and the exact text 'Read-only — this file is outside the registered project roots.' above the conflict banner when !writable; update the component doc comment. In EditorPane.test.tsx: add writable: true to every existing readFileAtPath resolved value, then add the three named tests from PRD WI-2.

items.title: Given readFileAtPath resolves with writable: false, when EditorPane renders, then the textarea has the readonly attribute, a fireEvent.change leaves its value at the loaded text, and the Save button is disabled
Given a writable: false file with focus in the textarea, when Ctrl+S or Cmd+S is pressed, then writeFileAtPath is never called
EditorPane renders editor-pane-readonly-note with the text 'Read-only — this file is outside the registered project roots.' for writable: false and does not render it for writable: true
The existing save, Ctrl/Cmd+S, split-pane, conflict, and reload tests pass with writable: true mocks, so a writable file still saves through writeFileAtPath

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-3 exactly in docs/MARKDOWN-EDITOR-PANE.md: retitle to '(PAN-3260, PAN-4583)'; change the readFileAtPath result to { text, lang, mtimeMs, totalLines, writable }; replace the shared-validation paragraph and containment bullet (lines 50-63) with the door-split description (read roots = home + write roots, write roots = project roots + OVERDECK_HOME, the two exact PATH_NOT_ALLOWED messages, writable meaning) while keeping the absolute-path, extension, regular-file, no-create, and 1 MiB bullets; add the read-only EditorPane paragraph; add a '## Who can call this door' section condensing the PRD's four-point Security analysis with its file references (ws-auth.ts authorizeDashboardUpgrade admin scope, access-tokens.ts scopeSatisfies, DASHBOARD-AUTH.md scope table, Shared Sessions has no host transport in this repo).
